closure_decision.reason: A hydrostatic conductive spike and a maintained radial Bondi flow have different high-collisionality limits. Collisionality alone does not specify the outer reservoir or radial flow state.
closure_decision.transition_solver: Use non-orbit-averaged radial kinetics when N_orb crosses unity inside the inflow path.

conductive_spike.adoption_reason: The harmonic-conductivity asymptotes fix p=1. The free-p fit is retained only as a diagnostic of the measured turnover shape.

dimensionless_turnover_calibration.interpretation: Kn_*=1 is the LMFP/SMFP crossing. The adopted p=1 is fixed by the opposite linear conductivity asymptotes. The free-p fit is a diagnostic of the digitized turnover shape.
dimensionless_turnover_calibration.scope: Hydrostatic, constant, isotropic cross-section conductive SIDM spike. Kn is the local mean free path divided by the transport scale height used by that calculation.

leave_one_out_refit_range.interpretation: Sensitivity to omission of one vector point; not a statistical confidence interval.

metadata.extraction: Black five-point vector markers transformed with the figure's affine axis coordinates
metadata.printed_C_consistency_note: The printed C value is incompatible with the plotted fit and the paper's stated 1.7 Msun/yr collisionless baseline. The calibration therefore refits C, A, and B jointly to the vector data.
metadata.scope: Constant isotropic cross-section, isolated conductive SIDM spike
metadata.source: Sabarish et al. 2025, A&A 703 A142, arXiv:2505.14779
metadata.warning: This benchmark is not a t-channel Yukawa or Bondi-inflow calibration.

fiducial_yukawa_halo.bondi_reservoir_identification: Diagnostic substitution rho_infinity=rho(r_in) and sigma_infinity=sigma_1d(r_in); the saved hydrostatic snapshot does not provide an asymptotic radial-flow reservoir.
fiducial_yukawa_halo.fixed_profile_scaling_warning: This threshold scales the saved profile linearly in sigma0/m. It is not a self-consistent high-cross-section halo solution.

additional_bondi_requirements: outer reservoir fixes density and sound speed
transonic solution connects to the capture surface
radial_collisionality_gate.continuum_gate_interpretation: For H approximately r, the default N_orb threshold corresponds to Kn<=0.1. A hydrodynamic solve must evaluate its own scale height.
